about.title: A full-service digital marketing agency in Khammam
paragraphs: K Digital is a full-service digital marketing agency that helps local businesses and growing brands get found online, build trust and turn attention into customers.
From your logo and first Instagram post to your Google ads, SEO and website, we build a complete online presence that works for you every day.

cards.title: Our Mission
cards.text: To make professional digital marketing simple and affordable for every business.

cards.title: Our Promise
cards.text: Honest strategy, creative content and measurable results.

services.title: Digital marketing services that bring real enquiries
services.lead: Eleven services, one accountable team. From social media and paid ads to SEO, branding and websites for businesses in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh.

items.name: Social Media Marketing
items.text: Content planning, posts, reels and stories, and community management for Instagram and Facebook. We build your brand voice and keep your page active and attractive.

items.name: Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram)
items.text: Targeted ad campaigns for leads, calls, WhatsApp messages and sales, with regular optimization to lower your cost per lead.

items.name: Google Ads
items.text: Show up when customers search “near me” or for your service. Search, display and local campaigns designed for enquiries.

items.name: LinkedIn Ads
items.text: B2B lead generation for IT companies, consultants and service providers who want to reach decision makers.

items.name: YouTube Ads
items.text: Video advertising that builds awareness and brings targeted viewers to your business.

items.name: SEO (Search Engine Optimization)
items.text: Get your website to rank on the first page of Google. Keyword research, on-page SEO, local SEO, technical fixes, blog content and backlinks, for steady free traffic month after month.

items.name: Logo Designing and Branding
items.text: A professional logo that represents your business. Logo design, colour palette, fonts, business card and social media profile kit, so your brand looks consistent everywhere.

items.name: Google Analytics and Tracking Setup
items.text: Know exactly where your customers come from. We set up Google Analytics 4, Search Console, Meta Pixel and conversion tracking, and give you easy monthly reports on visitors, calls, leads and ad results.

items.name: Google Business Profile (GMB) Creation and Optimization
items.text: Set up, verification, keyword-rich description, photos, services, posts and review management, so you rank in local search and Google Maps.

items.name: AI Videos
items.text: Product ads, promo reels, explainer videos and brand videos created with AI, delivered faster and at lower cost than traditional shoots.

items.name: Website Designing
items.text: Fast, mobile-friendly, SEO-ready websites with WhatsApp and call buttons, built to convert visitors into customers.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Still have a question? Call or WhatsApp us on {phone}. We respond within 24 hours.

items.q: How soon will I see results?
items.a: Ads can bring leads within days. Social media, SEO and GMB growth usually show clear results in 30 to 90 days.

items.q: Do you work with small businesses?
items.a: Yes. We have packages for local shops, service providers and companies.

items.q: Do I need to pay separately for ads?
items.a: Yes. The ad budget is paid directly to Meta or Google, and our management fee is separate. This keeps everything transparent.

items.q: Can you create videos without a shoot?
items.a: Yes. Our AI videos use your product images and brand details.

items.q: Can you design my logo and set up my whole brand?
items.a: Yes. We create your logo, colours, fonts and social media profile kit.

items.q: How do I know my marketing is working?
items.a: We set up Google Analytics and conversion tracking, and send you a simple report every month.
Yes, every month, in simple language.
